course.title: Khaemenes Open-Age Algebra I & Integrated Mathematics I
course.audience: Open-age, placement-based learners with demonstrated pre-algebra readiness
course.standards_status: Broad official-framework union; jurisdiction-specific review required for formal reporting.

units.title: Algebraic Reasoning, Real Numbers & Precision
units.essential_question: How do notation, units, properties, and precision make mathematical claims trustworthy?

units.title: Expressions, Properties & Polynomial Foundations
units.essential_question: How can algebraic structure help us simplify, compare, and generalize relationships?

units.title: Linear Equations, Formulas & Proportional Models
units.essential_question: How do equations preserve equality while representing real constraints and relationships?

units.title: Linear Inequalities & Absolute Value
units.essential_question: How do inequalities and absolute value describe ranges, tolerances, limits, and feasible choices?

units.title: Functions, Domain, Range & Multiple Representations
units.essential_question: How do functions connect inputs and outputs across equations, tables, graphs, and contexts?

units.title: Linear Functions, Regression & Modelling
units.essential_question: How can linear functions describe constant change, support prediction, and reveal model limitations?

units.title: Systems of Equations & Inequalities
units.essential_question: How do simultaneous constraints determine intersections, feasible choices, and optimized decisions?

units.title: Exponents, Sequences & Exponential Functions
units.essential_question: How do repeated multiplication and constant percent change create exponential patterns?

units.title: Polynomials, Operations & Factoring
units.essential_question: How do polynomial operations and factoring expose structure, zeros, and geometric relationships?

units.title: Quadratic Functions & Equations
units.essential_question: How do quadratic forms reveal zeros, vertices, rates of change, and maximum or minimum values?

units.title: Radicals, Rational Exponents & Coordinate Geometry
units.essential_question: How do radical forms and coordinate methods connect algebra, distance, and geometric constraints?

units.title: Statistics, Financial Mathematics & Evidence
units.essential_question: How can algebra and statistics support responsible financial and evidence-based decisions?

units.title: Integrated Mathematical Modelling Capstone
units.essential_question: How can a defensible mathematical model support a real decision while acknowledging uncertainty and limits?

readiness_bridge.incoming_policy: Prior Pre-Algebra evidence may preselect support; the Algebra I diagnostic confirms or adjusts routing.
